lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a non-uniform grid posterior to the gill slits, with a higher concentration of smaller spots in the anterior-dorsal section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light dorsal surface to a shadowed ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the right pectoral fin, suggesting physical trauma or a permanent notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least four smaller elongated silhouettes consistent with remoras swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral region.
